message: No detected input validation: The code selects datasets by string comparison and raises ValueError for unknown names, but performs no structural, dtype, shape, or value-range validation on the loaded data itself.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths (e.g., 'data/MNIST', 'data/UCI') with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks of any kind.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, label value validation, or label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is present anywhere in the visible code.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The code loads datasets directly without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code constructs models and references a pretrained argument and checkpoints directory, but no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision is performed when loading pretrained weights.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous training samples before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the visible training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanism is imported or used in the code.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code; evaluation is purely novelty/anomaly detection on clean data.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforced programmatically, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics; the code simply delegates to OneClassTestHelper without any such protections visible.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path loads datasets and passes them directly to the model helper without any shape, range, or schema validation of incoming inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is visible that checks model outputs for NaN values, probability bounds, or anomaly score thresholds before returning results.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM pipeline; it is a novelty detection system using autoencoders and density estimators on image/tabular data, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
